archetypes.name: dyn-preterminal
archetypes.rationale: Run-log label parsing and guard placement are the main correctness risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the pre-terminal outcome-label parser and guard wiring. Confirm it only targets canonical /implement summary headings, allows missing summaries, and runs after pre-commit staging but before commit on every intended pre-terminal path. Check that terminal post-merge paths remain unblocked. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
